title: Notes that start and stop
text: A VCA is a volume control something else turns. An Envelope makes a shape each time a key goes down (MIDI In's GATE): it rises (ATTACK), falls a little (DECAY), holds (SUSTAIN), and fades when you let go (RELEASE). The envelope into the VCA's CV opens it for each note. Try: a long ATTACK for a swell; SUSTAIN at 0 and a short DECAY for a pluck; a long RELEASE. Play chords: each note gets its own voice (VOICES at the top).
